PhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nine Chronicles accesses your photo library only when you choose to sign in with a QR code — for example, selecting the account QR code image you saved when you created your account. The selected image is scanned on your device to read the QR code and is never uploaded or shared.
PhotoLibraryAdditionsUsageDescription: Nine Chronicles saves an image to your photo library only when you choose Save Image while sharing your account QR code, so you can keep a backup of the code you use to sign in.
